paraphrase: a gourd grew beside a lofty pine
the gourd is luxuriant with foliage
the gourd embraces the pine's branches
the gourd overtops the pine's summit
the gourd thinks itself superior to other trees
the pine says the glory is very brief
winter will soon come and destroy the gourd
note: future; text variant: perdat (P31, P34) / perdet (P50, P21)
